## Summary

Describe the user-facing outcome and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` when behavior or layout changed

## Quality checks

- [ ] I kept the change focused.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I checked keyboard and reduced-motion behavior.
- [ ] I included screenshots for visual changes.
- [ ] New assets are original or appropriately licensed.
